title: Observability: metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerting for Optimize quality gate runs
creator: Allison Grant
description:
We’re rolling out mandatory quality evaluation gates for Optimize config changes (batching/caching/quantization profiles). This ticket delivers end-to-end observability for gate runs so we can: (1) detect real regression spikes, (2) identify flakiness/infra issues quickly, and (3) maintain an execution-latency SLO so gates don’t stall rollouts.

Scope
- Emit standard metrics, traces, and structured logs for gate lifecycle events (requested → validated → scheduled → running → retrying → completed) and decisions (passed/failed/overridden/canceled).
- Build and ship dashboards (funnel + failure/flakiness breakdowns) based on the dashboard spec.
- Wire alerting for: failure spikes, flake rate spikes, gate execution latency/SLO breaches, and eval-harness dependency issues.
- Add runbook links and drill-down paths from alerts → dashboard → traces/logs → artifacts.

Non-goals (this ticket)
- Building new eval metrics; we only surface/attribute what the eval-harness returns.
- Private/on-prem alerting packaging (we’ll keep this hosted-focused for limited rollout).

Primary stakeholders
- SRE: Sean Gallagher (paging strategy), Allison Grant (standards)
- Observability implementation: Sergio Costa
- Telemetry instrumentation: Caleb Johnson
- Optimize service owners: Jordan Lee / Michael Nguyen
- Eval-harness integration: Olivia Grant

References
- Confluence: observability standard: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/observability-standards/quality-gates-observability-standard.json
- Dashboard spec: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/quality-gates-dashboard-spec.json
- Runbook: sources/confluence/eng-sre/runbooks/runbook-optimize-quality-gate-failures.json
- Related PR (dashboards/alerts): sources/github/observability-pack/pr-883-quality-gates-dashboards-and-alerts.json
- Related PR (instrumentation): sources/github/redwood/pr-19593-add-gating-metrics-emission-and-tracing.json
acceptance_criteria: Metrics emitted for every gate run and decision, tagged sufficiently for route/model/config-type attribution (with cardinality limits).
Distributed trace spans present for Optimize → eval-harness trigger, retries, and result ingestion; trace links surfaced in logs.
Dashboards deployed to shared ‘Quality Gates’ folder with drill-downs and linked runbooks.
Pager alerts live for: gate failure spike, flake spike, gate execution latency SLO, and dependency error-rate spike; alerts include context and links.
Alert noise controls implemented (min run volume, burn-rate-ish thresholds, and separate warnings vs pages).
Oncall can answer within 5 minutes: is this a real regression vs infra flake vs capacity/timeout vs misconfiguration?
implementation_notes:
1) Metrics (Prometheus-style)
Naming convention: redwood_quality_gates_* (consistent with observability standard).

Core counters
- redwood_quality_gates_runs_total{env,region,tier,route_id,account_tier,model_family,model_id,config_change_type,gate_tier,result}
  - result ∈ passed|failed|canceled|overridden|error
- redwood_quality_gates_eval_requests_total{env,region,eval_cluster,gate_tier,attempt,result}
  - result ∈ success|timeout|rate_limited|capacity|error
- redwood_quality_gates_retries_total{env,region,reason}
  - reason ∈ flake_rerun|timeout|transient_5xx|capacity_backoff

Latency histograms
- redwood_quality_gates_run_end_to_end_seconds_bucket{env,region,gate_tier,config_change_type}
  - measures requested → terminal state
- redwood_quality_gates_eval_harness_roundtrip_seconds_bucket{env,region,eval_cluster,gate_tier}
  - measures trigger → response

Quality delta gauges (bounded cardinality)
- redwood_quality_gates_quality_delta{env,region,metric,gate_tier,config_change_type,model_family}
  - metric examples: task_success, rubric_overall
  - NOTE: do NOT tag by prompt_set_id here (too high cardinality). Prompt-set level is logged only.

Flakiness / variance
- redwood_quality_gates_flake_score{env,region,gate_tier,model_family}
  - derived from eval-harness response aggregation
- redwood_quality_gates_quarantined_prompt_sets_total{env,reason}

2) Tracing
- Span: optimize.gates.requested (attributes: gate_run_id, config_change_type, gate_tier, route_id_hash)
- Span: optimize.gates.preflight_validation (attributes: validation_result, rejection_reason)
- Span: optimize.gates.eval_harness.trigger (attributes: eval_run_id, attempt, eval_cluster, http_status)
- Span: optimize.gates.eval_harness.wait
- Span: optimize.gates.results.ingest (attributes: result, flake_score, quality_delta_summary)
- Span: optimize.gates.decision (attributes: decision, override_id if present)

Trace propagation
- Use existing request correlation header; additionally log gate_run_id in structured logs.

3) Structured logs (JSON)
- Event: quality_gate_run_state_changed
  - fields: gate_run_id, old_state, new_state, reason_code, actor (system/user), route_id, model_id, config_change_type, gate_tier
- Event: quality_gate_eval_harness_call
  - fields: gate_run_id, eval_run_id, attempt, latency_ms, result, error_class
- Event: quality_gate_decision
  - fields: gate_run_id, decision, quality_delta_summary, thresholds_summary, override_status

4) Dashboards
Panels (per dashboard spec)
- Gate funnel: created → running → completed (passed/failed/overridden)
- Failure rate by config_change_type (batching/caching/quant_profile)
- Failure rate by model_family + region
- Flake score distribution and rerun rate
- Gate runtime: p50/p95/p99 end-to-end, plus breakdown of time-in-queue vs eval runtime (where available)
- Top error reasons (timeouts, capacity, 5xx, validation rejects)
- Alert annotations: deploy markers (optimize service + eval-harness)

5) Alerting rules (initial)
Pages (PagerDuty)
- Quality Gate Failure Spike (P1 page)
  - condition: failure_rate > 10% AND total_runs >= 30 over 15m for env=prod, gate_tier=full
  - routed to: #eng-sre oncall + Optimize oncall rotation
- Gate Execution Latency SLO breach (P1 page)
  - condition: p95(end_to_end) > 25m for 30m window AND total_runs >= 20
  - rationale: blocked rollouts / degraded DX
- Eval-harness dependency errors (P1 page)
  - condition: eval_requests error/timeout > 5% AND total_eval_requests >= 50 over 10m (per region)

Warnings (Slack)
- Flake spike warning
  - condition: flake_score avg > 0.35 OR retries_total / runs_total > 0.2 over 1h
  - channel: #eng-ml + #eng-sre

Noise control / cardinality
- route_id is hashed/normalized for metrics; raw route_id and prompt_set_id only in logs.
- account_id never used as a tag; use account_tier + anonymized account cohort where needed.

Rollout
- Enable metrics/tracing in staging first; validate cardinality and sample rates.
- Production rollout behind feature flag: gates_observability_v1.
- After 48h, turn on alerts as warnings only; promote to paging once stable (flake rate below threshold).

comments: 2025-12-03 (Allison Grant): Please keep prompt_set_id out of metric labels. We saw a similar incident with ‘eval_suite’ exploding series count last quarter. OK to log it + include in trace attributes (sampled).

2025-12-08 (Sergio Costa): Drafted initial metric set and Grafana layout based on the dashboard spec. Need confirmation from Optimize on what ‘route_id’ format we can safely normalize/hash without breaking drill-down UX in Console.

2025-12-09 (Jordan Lee): For observability use route_id (UUID-ish) in logs; for metrics we can emit route_group (stable name) + route_id_hash. I’ll add route_group to the gate run record so we don’t have to reverse-map hashes manually.

2025-12-15 (Sean Gallagher): Paging criteria must include a min-volume guard. Also prefer region-scoped alerts for eval-harness timeouts so EU-West doesn’t page NA oncall without context. Add ‘eval_cluster’ label on the dependency alert.

2026-01-06 (Caleb Johnson): Implemented spans around eval-harness trigger and result ingestion. Need to verify propagation across async job boundary—currently we link via gate_run_id but don’t have full parent/child relationships for worker spans.

2026-01-12 (Sergio Costa): Dashboards in staging look good. Found an issue: retries were double-counted because both client and worker emitted the same counter. Fixing by moving retries_total emission to the orchestrator only.

2026-01-22 (Olivia Grant): Eval-harness now returns flake_score and rerun_count in the gate result payload. Please treat missing flake_score as ‘unknown’ (don’t default to 0) to avoid hiding partial failures.

2026-02-04 (Sergio Costa): Alerts created as Slack warnings first. We had a minor spike during GPU scarcity in eu-west; warnings correctly pointed at timeout/capacity. No pages fired due to min-volume guard.

2026-02-20 (Allison Grant): Promoting 2 alerts to paging for limited production rollout: eval-harness dependency errors + gate execution latency SLO. Keeping flake spike as warning until quarantine workflow is fully stable (ENG-3929).

2026-02-21 (Sergio Costa): Marking Done. Dashboards + alerts merged (observability-pack PR-883). Optimize instrumentation merged (redwood PR-19593). Runbook links verified. Post-launch action: revisit failure spike threshold after we have 2 weeks of production baseline.
